message:
Fix BroadcastLogger#tagged when broadcasting to multiple tagging loggers

[Fix #49757]

ActiveSupport::BroadcastLogger did not define #tagged, so it fell through to
method_missing. When broadcasting to more than one logger that responds to
:tagged, the else branch returned an Array of the individual loggers instead
of a logger, so BroadcastLogger#tagged("tag") without a block could not be
logged to (NoMethodError). With a block, method_missing invoked each logger's

Define #tagged directly on BroadcastLogger:

* Without a block it returns a new BroadcastLogger whose tagging-capable
  broadcasts are tagged; non-tagging broadcasts are kept as-is so they keep
  receiving messages.
* With a block it nests each tagging logger's own block form and yields the
  broadcast logger exactly once with every tag active. Nesting reuses each
  logger's ensure-based tag cleanup, so tags are popped even if the block
  raises.
